name: Mist Orb
notes: Mist Orb: wild monsters' moves lose accuracy points against the player at each of its 3 levels: 3, 2, 3 (-8 in all; 2.5 a level, taking turns since there are no half points), on top of the walking dodge. Adds that to boost_dodge. Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_dodge' (back to 0 each run).
title: MIST ORB
descriptions: WILD MOVES MISS YOU 2% MORE (+5% IN ALL)
WILD MOVES MISS YOU 3% MORE (+8% IN ALL)
